statement_nl: Apply L6 to the two valley-set possibilities from A14. If V(s) is the odd set, then s = Alt_n^+; if V(s) is the even set, then s = Alt_n^-. Conversely, A13 already showed that both Alt_n^+ and Alt_n^- are maximizers. Therefore, for every integer n at least 2, if s=(s_1,...,s_{n-1}) with each s_i equal to plus 1 or minus 1 and f(s)=F(s) counts permutations a of {1,...,n} satisfying s_i(a_{i+1}-a_i) > 0 for all i, then f(s) is maximal exactly for the two alternating sign sequences, equivalently exactly when s_i s_{i+1} = -1 for every i=1,...,n-2.
